rewrite_targets.reason: The Calibration and adaptation paragraph cites scalar conformalized quantile regression before contrasting it with joint multivariate membership after residual rescaling, but supplies no direct citation for the joint multivariate region family closest to the studied adaptive ellipsoids. The existing bibliography and provenance cover general conformal calibration, quantile intervals, cross-validation, and covariance shrinkage, without identifying a dedicated joint multivariate conformal-region comparator. One to three directly relevant sources would address this central positioning gap without changing the empirical comparisons or implying algorithmic novelty.
